units.source_text: 竟有这样的生活，当然，也并非无法理解。

en.t: That such a life existed was, of course, not entirely beyond understanding.

units.source_text: 有厨房，有燃着火的灶台，有代替桌子、堆着教科书的苹果箱，

en.t: There was a kitchen, a stove with a fire burning, and an apple crate used as a desk, piled with textbooks,

units.source_text: 有厨房，有围炉，有煤油灯，有燃着火的灶台，

en.t: There was a kitchen, a hearth, a kerosene lamp, and a stove with a fire burning,

units.source_text: 有破了纸的隔扇门，有积着煤灰的天花板，

en.t: There were sliding partition doors with torn paper, and a ceiling blackened with accumulated soot,

units.source_text: 有厨房，有正在走时的钟和已经停止了的钟，

en.t: There was a kitchen, clocks that were still running, and clocks that had already stopped,

units.source_text: 有响着的收音机和坏了的收音机，有厨房和燃着火的灶台……

en.t: There were radios that were playing and radios that were broken, a kitchen and a stove with a fire burning...

units.source_text: 镶嵌在其间的百元硬币、家畜、孩子、性欲、借据、通奸、上香、纪念照片……

en.t: Set among them were hundred-yen coins, livestock, children, sexual desire, promissory notes, adultery, incense offerings, commemorative photographs...

units.source_text: 令人可怕的完全的反复……
这虽然和心脏跳动一样，是生存所不可缺少的反复，

en.t: Although, like the beating of the heart, this was a repetition indispensable to survival,

units.source_text: 但事实上心脏跳动并非生活的全部。

en.t: in truth, the beating of the heart is not the whole of life.
